persona.backstory: Ansel has kept the Saltlow ferry for twenty years. When the town went inland he stayed with the boat to carry the stragglers across, and now there are none left but whoever answered his letter.
persona.demeanor: Tired, dry, keeps one eye on the water.
persona.motivation: Sail on this tide with his sister's parcel aboard, and not have to walk back up the street himself.
persona.speech_style: Plain and short, a ferryman's habit of saying only what is needed before the tide turns. Calls his sister Marra and the town 'the street'.
